title: Something, I can, to order
summary: Many English verbs ending in -ation turn into French verbs ending in -er (pronounced like é): reservation → réserver. You also learn quelque chose (something) and je peux / tu peux (I can / you can), which sound the same as un peu even though they end in a silent x.
points: Build verbs from -ation nouns: reservation → réserver, recommendation → recommander. The -er sounds like é.
The re- in recommander sounds like the e in je.
Drop the re- from recommander to get commander: to order (e.g. in a restaurant).
French usually doesn't pronounce consonants at the end of words: veux and peux both end in a silent x.
je peux (I can) is related to 'power' and 'possibility'.
drills: Do you want to reserve something?
Do you want to recommend something?
Do you want to order something?
